blocks.text:
After breakfast, an English-speaking guide will meet you in the hotel lobby.

A half-day tour lasting about 4 hours is planned.

First, you will head to Praia Vermelha, or Red Beach, where the cable car ascent begins.

The first stop is Urca Hill.

There is a large viewing platform here, as well as a restaurant and bar.

The next cable car section takes you to Sugar Loaf.

From the summit, enjoy a panorama of Rio: Copacabana, the bay, the surrounding mountains, ocean islands, the Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado.

After descending, the tour continues by car.

You will head to the central districts of old Rio.

The program includes historic churches and monasteries, the main cathedral and colonial architecture.

Return to the hotel after the tour.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, another half-day tour begins, lasting about 4 hours.

The tour is led by an English-speaking guide.

You will head to the station for the train that climbs to the summit of Corcovado.

The route passes through Tijuca Forest.

Tropical vegetation lines both sides of the railway. You may spot monkeys, birds and other animals in the forest.

The summit of Corcovado stands at approximately 700 m above sea level.

Here you will find the statue of Christ the Redeemer.

The statue is 38 m tall and was built in 1931.

From the viewing platform, you can see the Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and other parts of Rio.

Return to the hotel after the tour.
